slots.name: Fixed-topic monitor
slots.evidence: presence, unresolved, missing, available denominator, explicit proposition-specific stance only where supported
slots.cold_start: retain four rows with Not assessed / No qualifying text; never substitute absence

slots.name: Emerging issues
slots.evidence: new-to-observed-corpus theme or changed measured prevalence, baseline definition, country counts and original passages
slots.cold_start: Insufficient history to assess emergence; a current-day theme is not renamed an emerging issue

slots.name: Country discourse map
slots.evidence: frozen representation/reference, high-dimensional distance, projection diagnostics and observation dates
slots.cold_start: show a clearly cross-sectional map if structurally adequate, otherwise withhold; never draw artificial coordinates

slots.name: Rhetorical movement
slots.evidence: same-country/genre/issue baseline, observed dates, high-dimensional change and new source passage
slots.cold_start: No comparable prior observation / No new comparable text; not zero movement

slots.name: Discourse-network changes
slots.evidence: explicit edge layer, matched node coverage, edge sample denominator, baseline, stability and source passages
slots.cold_start: No comparable prior network; never infer coalitions from topical similarity
